$comment: StudioShare mascot — the one file to edit. moods: how each mood looks — the code-drawn rig's face, arms, prop and motion (or frame atlases from src/<mood>/<light|dark>/ when 3D renders exist). moments: what the mascot does at each moment in the app (keys are code constants: append-only, never rename). Run `node tools/mascot/pack.mjs --sync` after editing. Spec: the 'StudioShare Mascot — Expression & Moment Map' doc.

idle.pose: standing relaxed, arms loosely at its sides, soft gentle smile

waiting.pose: standing upright and leaning slightly forward, hands behind its back, attentive smile, eyes on the viewer
keyframes: head and eyes turned to its left
head and eyes turned to its right

shy.pose: both hands covering its eyes, one finger lifted to peek through, head turned a little away

happy.pose: closed-eye happy smile (eyes are upward arcs), one hand raised high in a wave, tiny yellow sparkles
keyframes: waving hand tilted outward
waving hand tilted inward

celebrating.pose: jumping in the air, both arms raised, big open smile, star-shaped glowing eyes, small yellow confetti around it
keyframes: crouched just before the jump, arms down, same big smile
highest point of the jump, arms up, confetti bursting

proud.pose: confident smile, one arm sweeping out to the side presenting something ("ta-da"), a small yellow sparkle at the hand

curious.pose: head tilted, one eye a little bigger, leaning in as if peeking around a corner, small yellow question mark beside the head

excited.pose: wide round surprised eyes, up on its toes, pointing forward with one hand, two yellow exclamation marks above the head

focused.pose: squinting focused eyes, leaning in, holding a small photographer's loupe up to one eye

carrying.pose: walking to the right with determined eyes, carrying a cardboard box in both arms
keyframes: same, left foot forward
same, right foot forward

thinking.pose: eyes looking up, one hand on its chin, three small yellow dots above its head
keyframes: eyes looking up-left
eyes looking up-right

searching.pose: holding a big magnifying glass, eyes looking sideways through it
keyframes: magnifying glass swept to its left
magnifying glass swept to its right

connecting.pose: hopeful smile, holding a cable plug out in both hands toward the side

connected.pose: satisfied smile, a plug clicked into a small socket with a yellow spark, thumbs-up with the free hand

disconnected.pose: sad eyes, shrugging, holding an unplugged cable that dangles from one hand

sleepy.pose: eyes closed, slumped and drooping, head tilted, yellow "zzz" above it

hot.pose: tired eyes, a sweat drop on its face, fanning itself with one hand

patient.pose: calm neutral face, glancing at a wristwatch on one wrist, one foot lifted to tap, a small yellow hourglass beside it

oops.pose: sheepish face with swirl eyes, scratching the back of its cap, a dropped photo card at its feet

sad.pose: downturned eyes with a single tear, shoulders dropped, arms hanging

locked.pose: neutral face, standing beside a small closed door, holding up a key

careful.pose: worried brow, both open palms raised forward ("hold on"), one foot stepping back

goodbye.pose: warm smile, waving while starting to turn and walk away
keyframes: waving hand tilted outward
waving hand tilted inward

ok.pose: winking, one thumbs-up, a small yellow tick beside it

scanning.pose: calm, eyes glowing brighter like a scanner, holding up a photo card with a face on it; yellow corner brackets around the face
keyframes: a thin glowing pink horizontal scan line across the top of the photo
the scan line across the middle of the photo
the scan line across the bottom of the photo

walk.pose: running to the right, seen from the front three-quarter, happy
keyframes: right leg forward, left arm forward
left leg forward, right arm forward

glance.pose: a quick wink, head turned toward the viewer, arms down

uploading.pose: walking to the right carrying a big yellow cloud with an upward arrow on it
keyframes: same, left foot forward
same, right foot forward

sending.pose: happily throwing a white paper plane forward with one hand

capturing.pose: holding a black DSLR camera up to its face with both hands, taking a photo

account.nudge.action: Holds a key, offers it; never blocks

attendees.importing.action: Carries a stack of name cards

auth.browserWaiting.action: Looks at an open browser window icon, taps foot; slows after 20 s

auth.otp.action: Covers eyes, peeks between fingers; one finger lifts per digit typed

auth.phone.action: Eyes follow the caret; nods per digit group

auth.signedIn.action: Wave, then walks out of frame into the app

auth.studioLaunched.action: Biggest celebration in the app: confetti, flash burst

auth.studioName.action: Holds a blank sign; letters appear on it as typed

auth.verifying.action: Holds the code up to the light

auth.welcome.action: Small wave, then looks from button to button as the pointer or focus moves

auth.wrongCode.action: Head shake, the code card crumples

campaign.sending.action: Postbag empties as the count rises

capture.firstPhoto.action: Catches the first photo in mid-air

capture.live.action: Catches each photo as it arrives; a small hop on every 10th

capture.quiet.action: Dozes holding the plug; wakes on the next photo

capture.setup.action: Points at the camera menu item for that step; a new pointing pose per step

capture.waitingForCamera.action: Looks out of a window; idle gets slower after 30 s

cull.allDecided.action: Small celebration in the header corner, 1.5 s, never blocks keys

cull.empty.action: Holds a loupe over an empty table

cull.modelsFailed.action: Toolbox dropped; counts down on its fingers

cull.paused.action: Asleep on the table; "Resume" wakes it

cull.running.action: Waits for the cull to finish, eyes on the progress; small nod as each batch lands

cull.scanning.action: Scan line sweeps across each frame, locking on faces and focus points

cull.sent.action: Seals the box, hands it to the courier

event.deleteConfirm.action: Hands up; no cute animation on the confirm itself

event.deleted.action: Small bow, fades out; no celebration

event.outOfCredits.action: Shows an empty wallet, points to "Buy credits"

events.empty.action: Holds an empty frame; the three steps (create, upload, share) light up one by one as it points

events.error.action: Dropped clipboard; retry picks it up

export.done.action: Hands over a ribbon-tied box; "Open folder"

export.running.action: Carries photos into a folder, speed = Mbps

faces.matching.action: Draws lines from faces to photos

faces.none.action: Scans the photo, no bracket locks on, shrugs

faces.reading.action: Scan line passes over each headshot

folder.empty.action: Points to "Import photos"; on desktop, mimes dropping a file

import.copying.action: Carries photos one by one; pace follows progress

import.readingOriginals.action: Holds the drive cable steady with both hands

orbit.jobRestored.action: Lifts the job out of the bin, dusts it

orbit.newBooking.action: Pops up from the inbox with a ringing bell

orbit.voidConfirm.action: Serious; no animation on the button

selection.inProgress.action: Watches hearts drop into the basket; one bounce per pick, throttled

selection.invited.action: Posts an envelope with a heart

state.sessionExpired.action: At a closed door holding the key; "Sign in again"

state.validation.action: Points at the first bad field

team.memberAdded.action: Puts the lanyard on a new figure

update.available.action: Holds a new box with a bow

update.required.action: Stands at the gate, "update to continue"

upload.done.action: Drops the last box into the cloud, cloud gets a tick

upload.facesReading.action: Scan line sweeps over each photo; a bracket locks on every face found

upload.failed.action: Box tipped over, one photo out

upload.offline.action: Box held, waiting at a closed road

upload.outOfCredits.action: Box stuck at a toll gate, points at "Buy credits"

upload.paused.action: Sleeps on the box; "Resume" wakes it

upload.uploading.action: Carries a box toward a cloud; speed follows throughput; stack shrinks, cloud grows

app.launch.action: Fades in, stretches once, then breathes

auth.providerOpening.action: Looks toward the sheet's side of the screen

auth.resendCountdown.action: Small watch in hand ticks with the timer

auth.launchingStudio.action: Hangs the sign above a door

account.switch.action: Packs a bag, then greets the new account

events.refresh.action: Tugs a rope at the top edge

badge.new.action: Event row badge, 16 dp: small spark

badge.upcoming.action: Event row badge, 16 dp: calendar page

badge.shooting.action: Event row badge, 16 dp: camera raised

badge.awaitingPhotos.action: Event row badge, 16 dp: empty tray

badge.cullPending.action: Event row badge, 16 dp: loupe lowered

badge.uploading.action: Event row badge, 16 dp: box with an up arrow

badge.readyToShare.action: Event row badge, 16 dp: link chain

badge.selecting.action: Event row badge, 16 dp: heart outline

badge.reselecting.action: Event row badge, 16 dp: heart with a circular arrow

badge.exportReady.action: Event row badge, 16 dp: ribbon box

event.nameTyping.action: Writes on the clipboard as you type

event.typeChosen.action: Swaps a tiny costume prop (veil, cap, lanyard)

event.retentionSet.action: Holds an hourglass; serious face, privacy matters

event.draftSaved.action: Slides the clipboard into a drawer

event.publishConfirm.action: Explains, then waits for the confirm

capture.entry.action: Holds a camera, looks at you

capture.brandPicker.action: Holds up camera silhouettes as you hover each brand

capture.exactValues.action: Magnifier on the value: dots matter

capture.connectNow.action: Holds a plug toward the camera

capture.hintValues.action: Points at the specific value, one hint at a time

capture.wrongUser.action: Shows two name tags that don't match

capture.secureMode.action: Unlocks a padlock icon, "turn this off"

capture.firewall.action: Small wall in front of it

capture.leaveWarning.action: Points back at the live badge

import.withoutCull.action: Carries the whole stack straight through

upload.pausedByUser.action: Puts the box down, sits on it

upload.resumed.action: Jumps up, picks the box back up

upload.background.action: Walks off with the box, waving

credits.unverified.action: Looking at a blank receipt; "Refresh balance"

cull.opened.action: Pulls a stool up to the table

cull.intro.action: Lock on a box: nothing leaves

cull.assisted.action: Holds a red flag (it only flags the worst)

cull.target.action: Fills a measuring cup to the level

cull.strictness.action: Squints harder at Extreme, relaxed at More

cull.judging.action: Sits beside the progress bar watching it fill, glancing back at you now and then

cull.again.action: Waits again while the folder is re-sorted (nothing is re-scanned)

cull.sendMaybes.action: Moves the Maybe pile to Sending

cull.draftWait.action: Box waits at a closed gate

cull.bulkRated.action: One-shot thumbs-up, 24 dp, never blocks keys

cull.keyHelp.action: Points at keys as you hover

selection.maxSet.action: Counts on fingers to the number

selection.hostDone.action: Ties a bow on that host's basket

selection.reselect.action: Empties the basket back onto the table, calmly

export.structure.action: Sorts into one box or many

export.partial.action: Few cards on the floor; "Retry failed"

qr.mapping.action: Ties a string from card to event

qrdirect.ready.action: Holds a ticket, timer on it

public.downloads.action: Hands out / holds back a photo

wall.unpublished.action: Covers the wall with a sheet

hosts.invitePhone.action: Holds a phone, waits for digits

hosts.inviteLink.action: Holds a key on a ring

hosts.seats.action: Sets out chairs, one per seat

team.rolePicker.action: Holds role cards (owner, manager, shooter, editor)

orbit.datesConfirmed.action: Circles a date on the calendar

orbit.createEvent.action: Carries the functions into a new event

orbit.closeable.action: Closes the folder with a stamp

orbit.paymentTooMuch.action: Coin bounces out of the jar

orbit.discardConfirm.action: Holds the draft over a bin

orbit.deleteConfirm.action: Carries it to a bin, gently

bookingForm.dirty.action: Pen in hand, waiting for Save

orbit.received.action: Coin stack grows with the sum

attendees.facesReading.action: Scan line passes over each headshot, brackets lock on

campaign.test.action: Sends a single envelope to itself

campaign.inline.action: Hand-delivers each envelope; "keep the app open"

watermark.editing.action: Stands beside the preview, nudges the mark as you drag

website.checklist.action: Holds a checklist, ticks as items finish

website.aiWritten.action: Presents the page; "read and change anything"

website.publishing.action: Carries the page to the window

diagnostics.consent.action: Holds the log closed until you tick the box

state.offlineSurface.action: Full pose, points to network settings

state.serverError.action: Fixing a server box with a spanner

auth.studioLaunched.pose: the biggest celebration: jumping high with both arms up under a hanging shop sign, confetti and a camera-flash burst
keyframes: crouched before the jump, looking up at the sign
mid-air, arms up, confetti and flash burst

event.published.pose: pulling a curtain cord, the curtain opening beside it, a spotlight on it, proud smile
keyframes: curtain closed, hand on the cord
curtain open, spotlight on

capture.firstPhoto.pose: catching a photo print in mid-air with both hands, delighted
keyframes: reaching up, photo falling toward it
photo caught, hugging it

upload.done.pose: dropping the last box into a big yellow cloud that shows a white tick
keyframes: lifting the box up to the cloud
box in, the cloud shows a tick, cheering

cull.sent.pose: sealing a cardboard box with tape and handing it forward
keyframes: taping the box shut
holding the sealed box out forward

cull.running.pose: sitting on a small stool beside a horizontal progress bar, eyes on the bar
keyframes: watching the bar
a small nod toward the bar

selection.completed.pose: cheering beside a row of small baskets with hearts, confetti
keyframes: arms half up beside the baskets
arms fully up, confetti

orbit.newBooking.pose: popping up from an inbox tray, ringing a small bell
keyframes: bell tilted left
bell tilted right

orbit.paidInFull.pose: holding up a glass jar full of sparkling gold coins, celebrating
keyframes: jar held at the chest
jar held up high, coins sparkling

website.live.pose: flipping a small hanging shop sign to "OPEN", lights coming on
keyframes: hand on the sign showing "CLOSED"
sign flipped to "OPEN", proud smile
